The converse lower bound for arbitrary normal projective planes follows from mod-two intersection parity and Poincaré duality.

value.rationale: The \(24\)-cell quotient is a canonical highly symmetric triangulation of \(\mathbb{RP}^3\). The result gives an exact minimum for the unique essential normal projective-plane class, proves that the lower bound is attained in exactly \(60\) ways, and classifies the minima by symmetry and normal-disk type. This is structural normal-surface information not determined by topology, face numbers, or the previously known primal cycle spectrum.
